title: Smores with Yummi Pops Nacho and Sea Salt
description: A playful s'mores twist with crunchy Yummi Pops Nacho and a hint of sea salt.
instructions: Add the Yummi Pops Sea Salt to a deep plate.
Crush the cookies over the popcorn. Add the marshmallows.
Pour in the melted chocolate, stir and serve.
chef_tips: Melt the chocolate over low heat so it stays fluid and glossy without scorching.
Add the marshmallows just before serving to enjoy their full softness and fluffiness.
Mix Yummi Pops Sea Salt and Nacho flavors together for an irresistible sweet-salty combo.
